card.name: Researchers say, in news reports
card.fires_on: The reporting verb 'say' or 'said' right after a group such as Researchers or Experts, or after a named expert, in news-style health or science writing. It also fires weakly at the end of a sentence or quote just before the next statement begins.

card.writes: It seems to promote odd short or rare word pieces, with no clear link to what follows 'say'.
card.plain: It lights up on 'say' or 'said' when a news story tells us what researchers or experts claim.
